name: Calming Grain

strengths: Easy to digest, grows in low-nutrient soil.
handlingTips: Harvest when the seeds feel soft and oily.
applications: Primary fodder for Cluck-Striders; used in 'Serenity Porridge'.

weaknesses: Requires high heat to become edible.

applications: Brewed into Root Mash Ale; staple starch for Mountain Dwarves.

name: Goldhusk Wheat

applications: Used in Faeberry Liqueur; mana-restoration medicine.
